findings.highlight: I can only use strengthening magic
findings.evidenceJa: 強化しかできない
findings.governingReading: I can only use Reinforcement
findings.explanation: The named technique is again diluted into generic strengthening magic.

findings.highlight: It’s exactly like the time I got attacked by Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に襲われた時の再現か
findings.governingReading: Is this a recreation of when Tohsaka attacked me?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative recognition of reenacting a tactic becomes categorical identity with the prior event.

findings.highlight: I also take another leg while I’m at it
findings.evidenceJa: ついでだから、ともう一本椅子の脚を頂戴した
findings.governingReading: While I am at it, I help myself to one more chair leg
findings.explanation: The lightly comic phrasing of appropriating school property is flattened.

findings.highlight: Things made out of inhuman bones
findings.evidenceJa: 人ではないモノの骨で作られた人形
findings.governingReading: dolls made from the bones of something nonhuman
findings.explanation: The enemies’ constructed doll nature becomes generic “things.”

findings.highlight: Golem, it’s a kind of a familiar
findings.evidenceJa: ゴーレム、使い魔の類
findings.governingReading: Golems—some variety of familiar
findings.explanation: The English number and article produce a malformed technical identification.

findings.highlight: the bones
findings.evidenceJa: 奇怪な骨人形
findings.governingReading: the grotesque bone puppets
findings.explanation: The enemies are reduced from animated constructs to loose bones.

findings.highlight: bone creature
findings.evidenceJa: 骨人形
findings.governingReading: bone puppet
findings.explanation: The repeated construct term becomes a generic creature.

findings.highlight: sadness
findings.evidenceJa: 悲壮
findings.governingReading: grim, tragic resolve
findings.explanation: One of Shirou’s frozen normal responses is determined resolve under tragedy, not ordinary sadness.

findings.highlight: cowardice
findings.evidenceJa: 逃走
findings.governingReading: the urge to flee
findings.explanation: A survival response is moralized into a character flaw.

findings.highlight: the two swords
findings.evidenceJa: 二つの武器
findings.governingReading: the two weapons
findings.explanation: The reinforced chair legs are prematurely recast as actual swords.

findings.highlight: swing them like I saw him use them
findings.evidenceJa: ただ見よう見まねで振り続ける
findings.governingReading: keep swinging them through sheer visual imitation
findings.explanation: The English adds an unspecified male model and a more concrete copied technique.

findings.highlight: I smash the fourth bone creature
findings.evidenceJa: 四体目の骨を薙ぎ払う
findings.governingReading: I sweep the fourth bone puppet aside
findings.explanation: The lateral clearing action is replaced by another generic smash.

findings.highlight: gets smashed and smacked into a wall
findings.evidenceJa: 今までにないほど砕け
findings.governingReading: shatters more thoroughly than any before and is hurled into the wall
findings.explanation: The escalation caused by Shirou protecting Rin disappears.

findings.highlight: I attack the defenseless body with the weapon in my left hand
findings.evidenceJa: 左の武器を叩きつけた
findings.governingReading: I slam the left-hand weapon into its exposed torso
findings.explanation: Concrete two-weapon choreography is reduced to generic attack.

findings.highlight: But there are more of them.
findings.evidenceJa: だが数は減らない
findings.governingReading: But their number does not diminish
findings.explanation: The pressure comes from no visible reduction despite kills, not simply the existence of more enemies.

findings.highlight: Why don’t you guys run out
findings.evidenceJa: いい加減品切れになれってんだ
findings.governingReading: Would you run out of stock already?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inventory-depletion joke becomes unnatural English.

findings.highlight: Ein K[ouml]rper ist ein K[ouml]rper
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=灰]r[ruby text=は]p[ruby text=灰]e[ruby text=に]r ist e[ruby text=塵]i[ruby text=は]n[ruby text=塵]
findings.governingReading: The surface incantation carries a ruby layer reading “ashes to ashes, dust to dust”
findings.explanation: The entire semantic ruby layer of Rin’s incantation disappears.

findings.highlight: lowers her shoulders in relief
findings.evidenceJa: 両肩を下げる
findings.governingReading: lets both shoulders drop
findings.explanation: The bodily release is explicitly labeled relief although the narration does not name the emotion.

findings.highlight: It is a pure hell here.
findings.evidenceJa: まさしく地獄だった
findings.governingReading: It was hell itself.
findings.explanation: The climactic entry line is rendered in conspicuously non-English idiom.

findings.highlight: The moanings I hear are just hallucinations.
findings.evidenceJa: うめき声は、ただの錯覚
findings.governingReading: the groans I seem to hear are only an illusion
findings.explanation: The English uses malformed “moanings” and medicalized hallucinations for a sensory illusion.

findings.highlight: It reminds me of a mountain of corpses, trash thrown away in a wasteland.
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れ伏す生徒たちの顔は青ざめ、蝋細工のように動かない
findings.governingReading: No corresponding Japanese sentence follows the active waxwork description.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally adds a mountain-of-corpses and wasteland-trash image absent from the original Japanese script.

findings.highlight: as she beholds the scene in horror
findings.evidenceJa: 何らかの感情を抑える為か
findings.governingReading: perhaps to suppress some emotion
findings.explanation: The narration deliberately leaves Rin’s emotion unidentified; the English fixes it as horror.

findings.highlight: On his butt
findings.evidenceJa: 尻餅をつき
findings.governingReading: sitting where he had fallen backward
findings.explanation: Shinji’s frightened collapsed posture is rendered in crudely comic wording.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka goes near Shinji
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二に詰め寄る遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin closes in on Shinji
findings.explanation: Rin’s threatening pressure becomes neutral proximity.

findings.highlight: it’s not me that killed her
findings.evidenceJa: 殺したのは僕じゃない
findings.governingReading: I’m not the one who killed [them/it]
findings.explanation: Before Rider is revealed on the floor, the English supplies a female victim and spoils the staged discovery.

findings.highlight: students that fell unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 倒れ伏した生徒たち
findings.governingReading: the collapsed students
findings.explanation: The students’ visible posture becomes a confirmed diagnosis before Shirou checks them.

findings.highlight: A stunned voice
findings.evidenceJa: 間の抜けた声
findings.governingReading: a blank, foolish-sounding response
findings.explanation: Rin’s momentarily vacant reaction is generalized to shock.

findings.highlight: a jack
findings.evidenceJa: 万力か何か
findings.governingReading: a vise or similar crushing tool
findings.explanation: The imagined implement producing Rider’s wound is mistranslated.

findings.highlight: ripped off the meat and bone by crushing it
findings.evidenceJa: 押し潰す事によって肉と骨をえぐり取った
findings.governingReading: crushed inward and gouged away flesh and bone
findings.explanation: The direction and gruesome mechanism of the wound are blurred.

findings.highlight: Rider disappears from this world
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーが消滅する
findings.governingReading: Rider dissipates
findings.explanation: A Servant’s technical disappearance is recast as a broad existential departure.

findings.highlight: as I thought
findings.evidenceJa: 張っていた物だったらしい
findings.governingReading: apparently had been erected by this Servant
findings.explanation: The English adds prior certainty to Shirou’s inference.

findings.highlight: causing this panic
findings.evidenceJa: 騒ぎを起こした
findings.governingReading: causing this incident or disturbance
findings.explanation: Rin accuses Shinji of causing the event; the English narrows its consequence to panic.

findings.highlight: I’m sure you’re next
findings.evidenceJa: 必ずアンタを始末しにくる
findings.governingReading: they will certainly come to eliminate you
findings.explanation: The threat’s agent, action, and certainty are weakened.

findings.highlight: a harmless insect can’t kill humans
findings.evidenceJa: 羽虫じゃ人間は殺せない
findings.governingReading: a gnat cannot kill a human
findings.explanation: The specific belittling image becomes “harmless” before Rin explains that judgment on the next page.

findings.highlight: It might be annoying having you run around
findings.evidenceJa: うろちょろして見苦しい
findings.governingReading: your scurrying about may be unsightly
findings.explanation: Rin’s contempt for Shinji’s undignified movement becomes personal annoyance.

findings.highlight: That’s the only value in you right now.
findings.evidenceJa: その程度の価値しかない
findings.governingReading: That is all the value you have right now
findings.explanation: The threat is rendered with a conspicuously non-English preposition.

findings.highlight: lost her calmness
findings.evidenceJa: 我を失っている
findings.governingReading: is beside herself
findings.explanation: The degree of Rin’s loss of self-control is weakened.

findings.highlight: biting her lips in vexation
findings.evidenceJa: 悔しげに歯を噛んでいる
findings.governingReading: gritting her teeth in frustration
findings.explanation: The bodily sign of contained emotion is assigned to the wrong part of the mouth.

findings.highlight: Her face is that of Tohsaka Rin
findings.evidenceJa: その横顔は、いつもの遠坂凛の物
findings.governingReading: Her profile is the familiar Tohsaka Rin’s
findings.explanation: The side-view composition and recognition of Rin’s usual public face are flattened.

findings.highlight: a mature magus
findings.evidenceJa: 一人前の魔術師
findings.governingReading: a full-fledged magus
findings.explanation: Professional competence is changed into personal maturity, muddying the contrast with a girl her age.

findings.highlight: wounds are caused by magic
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術による傷
findings.governingReading: injuries caused by magecraft
findings.explanation: The practical classification guiding whether to contact the Church is generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: It’d be troublesome for us
findings.evidenceJa: 後々厄介なので
findings.governingReading: because it would cause complications later
findings.explanation: The reason for Kotomine’s cover story becomes narrowly self-interested trouble for Shirou and Rin.

findings.highlight: at my school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校にいる
findings.governingReading: at the school
findings.explanation: The English unnecessarily shifts the inference into Shirou’s possessive perspective.

findings.highlight: I feel weird
findings.evidenceJa: 背中がむずむずする
findings.governingReading: it makes my back itch
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic bodily image for expecting Rin to strike him disappears.

findings.highlight: in fear of not knowing when I’ll get hit from behind
findings.evidenceJa: いつ背後から叩かれるか不安になって
findings.governingReading: because I start worrying about when she will smack me from behind
findings.explanation: The explanatory fragment becomes awkwardly abstract English.

findings.highlight: My head got all boiled up
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前が真っ赤になった
findings.governingReading: I saw red
findings.explanation: Shirou’s visual anger idiom becomes an invented boiled-head image.
